summary.intent: Run compound engineering retrospectives to flow session learnings into core files, dogfood Cohezion with Lemonade local inference via a CAS classifier adapter, build a multimodal journey rendering pipeline, and close the compound learning loop by fixing vault/SurrealDB persistence.
summary.outcome: Built and verified: CAS classifier adapter (21 tests, ~350ms/classify on Vulkan GPU), Lemonade MCP server (13 tools), journey rendering pipeline (physics → LLM narration → TTS → sonification → viz in ~13s), KnowledgeOracle cross-store search, and Stop hook for auto-persistence. Fixed vault MCP (FastMCP v1.26 ASGI breaking change), discovered and documented the dual-port Lemonade architecture, and verified Graph HIHO at 0.542.

repo: Two Lemonade server instances run simultaneously: port 13306 (system, /usr/bin/lemond) runs GPU Vulkan + CPU models; port 13307 (vendor, embedded in vendor/) runs NPU FLM models only — CAS and MCP must target 13306

System Lemonade config defaults to ROCm backend which hangs at 100% CPU on gfx1151 (Strix Halo); must run 'sudo -u lemonade lemonade config set llamacpp.backend=vulkan' once to persist Vulkan as default
Qwen3-8B-GGUF requires '/no_think' prefix in prompts — without it, all tokens are spent on internal reasoning and the response content is empty string with no error
gemma3-4b-FLM (NPU model) returns <pad> tokens for chat prompts — FLM models are NPU-optimized and only suitable for embeddings/perception tasks, not instruction-following
lemonade pull via API registers model metadata only; actual checkpoint download happens at load time via CLI (lemonade pull <model>) not the HTTP API
SurrealDB synapses store source/target as strings ('neurons:abc123') not record links (neurons:abc123) — all relational IN/INSIDE queries fail silently; must use string-cast matching
sd-cpp binary missing RPATH for libstable-diffusion.so — image generation blocked unless LD_LIBRARY_PATH is manually set; Vulkan backend not available for sd-cpp on this system
FastMCP v1.26.0 breaking change: FastMCP object is no longer directly callable as ASGI — must use mcp.sse_app() to get the ASGI handler; affects cloud-vault-mcp which was returning 500 on all routes

CompoundExecutor persistence (persist_prompt_artifact, persist_universe_snapshot, SkillRefiner) only fires during programmatic task execution, not interactive coding sessions — all persistence during human sessions was previously manual
JourneyNarrator was a no-op stub returning empty string; BaseAgent used it but got nothing
CAS classifier training data accumulates automatically on every successful Lemonade classification call and is the only auto-collecting feedback mechanism currently wired
Graph HIHO = 0.542 (target 0.5±0.15) when computed with string-cast matching; naive record-link queries report 0.000 due to type mismatch

code.finding: FastMCP v1.26 broke ASGI: changed from 'mcp_app = mcp' to 'mcp_app = mcp.sse_app()' — one line fix that restored all 56 vault MCP tools

New file: full multimodal pipeline — ManifoldEnv physics simulation → Qwen3 narration via Lemonade → Kokoro TTS → numpy data sonification → matplotlib 4-panel dashboard

workflow: API 500 errors on very long sessions are context-size related, not code bugs — the fix is starting fresh sessions and relying on the compound loop (Stop hook + KnowledgeOracle) to carry state
Lemonade 'pull' via API is a no-op for checkpoints — use CLI 'lemonade pull <model>' to actually download weights, then load via API
For sd-cpp on Strix Halo: binary works when LD_LIBRARY_PATH includes its own directory; Vulkan backend unavailable; ROCm backend installed but broken for LLMs
SurrealDB HIHO queries require string-cast workaround: WHERE string::concat('neurons:', string::slice(meta::id(id), 8)) IN (SELECT VALUE source FROM synapses)
FastMCP SSE testing via curl requires two-step: POST to /sse gets session_id, then POST to /messages with that session_id; response comes back as SSE event on original connection not POST response
For large retrospectives, read all 8 core files in parallel (KEY_LEARNINGS, MISSION_JOURNAL, CLAUDE.md, README, MEMORY.md, CONSTITUTION, CHARTER, CAPABILITY_MAP) before any edits
Prior art research should precede any novel capability claims — AMD GAIA, AgentLens, AIive, RLInspect all predate various 'first' claims and need to be acknowledged

The compound loop only fires during programmatic CompoundExecutor.execute_task() calls, not interactive Claude Code sessions — all persistence during human sessions requires explicit retrospective or Stop hook
